rationale: The Latin anchor *meretrix vel scortum* (prostitute/harlot) makes clear this entry refers to a female agent noun (a woman who performs a certain act), not to "action" as an abstract concept. The English gloss token "action" here is likely a fragment of a compound gloss (e.g. "woman of action/trade") rather than a standalone sense matching any of the offered WordNet synsets, which all describe abstract processes, states, or events rather than a person. None of the candidates captures the sense of a female practitioner implied by the Latin.
